steps.name: Withered Knight
steps.text: Guah... Uhhh—

steps.name: Withered Knight
steps.text: Aaah... ah...

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Report. The Withered Knight is displaying rejection symptoms after the injection.

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: No... We didn't observe similar reactions in the other knights. The pharmacists think it could be an allergic reaction that occurs in Sarkaz.

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: What? T-That's a waste...

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: It's almost as concentrated as the restoration gels they sell in stores as it is... This stuff is for fixing armor, and they're human. If we keep injecting this into their bodies, we'll end up causing irreparable damage to their brains...

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Okay, I understand... They're Sarkaz... not human...

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: *Sigh*... You heard them. Increase the concentration by another 0.3%... We'll find out the Sarkaz limit.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: What... are you?

steps.name: Withered Knight
steps.text: Gkhaa... Gkhaa...

steps.name: Corrupted Knight
steps.text: You... Nightzmora... must die...
The young Nightzmora lets out a long sigh. He looks up to find the familiar night sky has been dispelled by the bright lights of the city.
Is this, too, a symbol of a civilization's advancement? Is Kazimierz conquering the night skies with its bright neon lights?
He finds himself struck with a sense of melancholy.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Hey!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Maria!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Thank goodness... You're okay!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: U-Uh, Zofia? P-Please. Don't cry...

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: I'm glad you're alright, Maria.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: How were we supposed to face Old Nearl if something happened to you?

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Not that we can face him the way things are now.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Ahaha... You're not that old. What are you talking about? *cough*.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Uhh... Zofia? Could you let go... Please?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Sorry to interrupt this exemplary show of sisterly love... but it seems Margaret is missing?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Uh... When did you...?

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: I've been here since the hugging.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Ugh... Who are you again?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Oh, this guy helped me out just now—

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: It's you! Y-You're...

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: A case of mistaken identity, Old Knight.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: So? Where's Margaret?

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: After all that ruckus, is the insensitive Radiant Knight still going to carry on with the Major, foolhardy as she is?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I... I don't know if we should tell her...

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Heh.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: The Armorless Union isn't going to give up so easily. They'll attack again sooner or later. You're all in danger!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: But... telling Margaret is exactly what they want us to do...

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: This is the Grand Knight Territory. There is nowhere to run. They'll always find you.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: These are different times, not like before. The General Chamber of Commerce is growing even as we speak.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: This is for your own safety, Maria. We have to tell Margaret.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Is that really going to solve anything?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Are they really going to give up just because she pulls out of the Major?

a.text: Do the knights clinging to life in this city have no way out left?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: (W-What am I thinking...?)

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: It's not a bad thing to be so lost in thought. So long as you're not like a certain someone, anyway.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Okay, if Margaret isn't here, I still have something else to attend to. Cheerio.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Hold on, what are you—

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Zofia.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Let him go. Don't ask any more. It's okay.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Alright then...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: I owe you for saving Maria though. If there's anything we can do to help... let us know.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Hm... Right. Your attack glanced to the side, Maria. Your balance was off, and you were a little too slow too.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Seems like this is an emotional problem, though, and I can't pretend I know how girls work.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Is it an emotional problem?

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Knights don't fight on the battlefield.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: You won't be getting very far on borrowed ideals alone.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Confessarius. Seriously? Just the name gives me chills.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: If you're going to question that, try Darksteel.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: I'll pass... He's a Sarkaz too, isn't he? Something like a legendary mercenary?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: A Sarkaz from Kazdel, the Radiant Knight, and this Rhodes Island... Interesting.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Interesting, and also in the way.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: We have to deal with both the Board and the Knights Association, we have to take care of the Infected so discreetly, and we even have to be careful and cautious about it. When will all this be over?

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Soon...

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Right... soon.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: But Darksteel doesn't step up. Doesn't that mean we'll have to take care of all this dirty work ourselves?

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Wait.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Let's show some mercy. Why not?

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: They lost. I have the right to do whatever I want with them.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: They are my kin, and I can't bear to see my kin end up like this in Kazimierz. Let me take care of them.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Your kin... heh.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: These filthy creatures don't deserve to be my war prize.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: I'll break one arm each for their punishment. Take them away, the eyesores.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Ah, that's it? I thought we'd have to fight to come to an agreement.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Eh, hey now. Keep your blade where it is. Forget I said anything.

steps.name: A Voice on the Television
steps.text: Reigning victorious over the Candle Knight, the Radiant Knight is making huge waves in both in the media and on the intercity net.

steps.name: A Voice on the Television
steps.text: Furthermore, citizens are trembling in fear with Infected terrorism on the rise across the Grand Knight Territory.

steps.name: A Voice on the Television
steps.text: Area 0's officer-in-charge and a General Chamber of Commerce spokesman have announced they will hold a press conference in the upcoming days.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Anyway... That's about the size of it, Doctor, Miss Amiya.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: I'm afraid... things aren't very calm in Area 0 these days, and the Infected are taking the fall for the uprisings that happened the other day.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: These are extraordinary circumstances... but we don't want to put a stop to the sheltering and medical treatment just because of this.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Please avoid wandering around town the next couple days. I'm very sorry.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor... the news...

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: It's not 100% false, unfortunately.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: The Infected have actually been making a lot of noise, especially after the Radiant Knight defeated the Candle Knight.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: We had eleven cases of violence just yesterday.

options: Gossip is a fearful thing, and the media knows that best.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Apparently some of the Board members were assaulted?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Whoa... There are even protests going on.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I just hope it won't affect the knights... That lady yesterday said she'd buy toys for her siblings with her winnings.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Then... does that mean Nearl is...

steps.name: Protestors
steps.text: Deport the Infected! The Infected don't belong in the Grand Knight Territory!

steps.name: Protestors
steps.text: The Infected quarantine zone is an Oripathy petri dish!

steps.name: A Commuting Worker
steps.text: What's going on here? I just got out of my meeting. How did things get so out of hand?

steps.name: A Hurrying Worker
steps.text: Hm? Look at that city block over there. Isn't that the Infected shelter and treatment center?

steps.name: A Hurrying Worker
steps.text: The protest's let up a little already. It was way worse this afternoon. They had a huge banner, too.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Do you need something?

steps.name: A Protesting Knight
steps.text: The Radiant Knight... Do you know why those Infected dare do this out in the open?

steps.name: A Protesting Knight
steps.text: They're committing terrorist attacks all over the city, dragging innocent citizens into the fray. Do you know where they got the courage to do this?

steps.name: A Protesting Knight
steps.text: It was you! It was you and the Blood Knight. It was you infected knights who gave them the right the resist!

steps.name: A Protesting Knight
steps.text: I... I know you're no villain, champion. I even used to be a fan of yours.

steps.name: A Protesting Knight
steps.text: But by staying in the Major, you are only giving the Infected false hope.

steps.name: A Protesting Knight
steps.text: False hope that... they can change the status quo.

steps.name: A Protesting Knight
steps.text: You'd do well to keep your nose clean, Radiant Knight... Don't end up regretting your actions.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: What's the matter, Nearl?

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: You don't look like a knight who just won a match.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: No...

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: Nearl.

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: If there's something on your mind, tell us.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Right... I'm just thinking about the Infected.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: About that... we have another lead. Amiya knows already. There's no doubt that someone is behind all this.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: But you don't need to worry about that right now.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Trust me, and trust Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: Keep your light shining bright, and worry about nothing else, Nearl.

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: At the same time... Please don't push yourself either. You're strong, but your exhaustion is building up.

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: Try to take it easier once in a while.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Kazimierz... is my home.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: I'm very happy to see Maria all grown up and aiming to become a knight, and that Zofia and Old Marcin are both doing well...

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: But, right this moment, I feel more relieved that you two are here by my side.

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: Are we your family too, Nearl?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: It's hard to say, Liz.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: It'll be some time before winter comes, but it still gets pretty chilly at night here in Kazimierz. Liz, go back to Amiya.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: We've all been worried about you ever since you 'left' Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: I know, but that's exactly why I can't drag them into my own mess.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: But you're fine dragging us into it?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: You're free to leave now, if you want.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Well, well, look at you. Our Radiant Knight acting all snarky.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Music...? Is there a bar nearby?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: It used to be a row of regular old offices here. If I remember correctly, there was a publisher.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: The Grand Knight Territory wasn't this big...

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: But, for the past couple decades, every time there was a Major, the Grand Knight Territory would pick out three cities to dock with after a round of competitive bidding.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: The Kawalerielki Alliance.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: The city's changing... and even though this is my home, it feels a little... foreign.

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: You haven't been back for very long yet, Nearl.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: And you dove straight into the Kazimierz Major right away... you chose to throw yourself into your ideals.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: You haven't started living a new, proper life here just yet.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: I will, sooner or later. But now's not the time.

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: You must be tired... I can feel it.

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: Should we take a walk? The night breeze might sweep away some of your exhaustion.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Sure. Take my hand.

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: How tough was the Candle Knight?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: I was surprised to find a knight like her in Kazimierz these days.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: She's strong, but her hesitation proved to be her weakness. It's too bad we couldn't face each other when she's at her best.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Did you enjoy it?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: I used to despise knight sports. No... even now, I feel nothing but sorrow for the shape Kazimierz is in.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: But... haven't we been through a lot together?
The three friends walk slowly down the street under the Kazimierz night sky.
Far away from the loud markets and hustle and bustle, only traces of the city's warmth can be felt in this alley.
The warmth comes from liquor and song, as well as the aroma of baked goods that yet lingers as pedestrians come and go.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: This doesn't change what we need to do.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: And that's even if, after everything has come to pass, my journey is destined to be ridiculed.
—Like wings taking flight in the night breeze.
—Like a traveler with a heart full of dreams.
—The knight sets out on her journey.
—In search of true love.

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: What a beautiful voice...

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Maybe it's a wandering singer.

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: Is there a place so romantic in Kazimierz too?

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: It's proof that there are people who live here.
—A fate as fragile as a cornflower.
—To face a test fierce as windstorms.

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: Hmm... Hmhmm...

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Liz, would you care to dance?

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: Huh? Me? What...?

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: It's fine. Take my hand.

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: Alright...

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: Oh... S-Slow down, Nearl...

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Alright.
The blue bird takes flight in the gentle night sky.
It dances amongst the glowing neon towers and navigates through a gently flowing river of time.
Taking the Sarkaz's hand, the knight waltzes back and forth under the dim lamplights.
The sight is reminiscent of the noblest statues found in Laterano.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: You're beautiful, Liz.

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: R-Really?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Perhaps you will actually be able to dance one day.

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: When that day comes... will you be there by our side?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Of course.
The knight stops and kneels down before the lady of the lamp.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: I promise, Liz.

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: Mhm...

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: We'll be waiting, Nearl.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: At the end of your journey, before your light burns out, we'll be there with you.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: When the time comes, if—

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Nearl.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Good evening, Radiant Knight... and the lovely Sarkaz ladies.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: I'm absolutely delighted to see you again so soon.
